title: A repertoire entry is not a performance record
subtitle: Follow the links between a dramatic work, a manual, an event and an interpretation.
summary: Follow the links between a dramatic work, a manual, an event and an interpretation. Use an Ammannur institutional entry to identify which links are still missing.
audience: General readers; all selected evidence and task instructions are included.
scope: Dated English institutional listing only. No Sanskrit/Malayalam text, manual, actual event segment, translation or gesture instruction is supplied.

passages.title: Institutional historical account
passages.text: The Ammannur Gurukulam site describes family teaching and a later training/performing institution; its homepage gives 27 October 1982 as the organisation’s start. Undated prose and older announcements do not verify a current roster or curriculum.
passages.context: Original bounded summary of the dated source reading; see source scope and limits.

passages.title: A named repertoire entry
passages.text: The plays page identifies Asokavanikamkam as the fifth act of Ashcharyachoodamani, attributed there to Mahakavi Sakthibhadra, with a sixteen-day description. This is the page’s English listing, not an observed event duration.
passages.context: Original bounded summary of the dated source reading; see source scope and limits.

passages.title: Different kinds of record
passages.text: The page distinguishes some stage-manual and acting-manual entries. No corresponding manual passage was read for this lesson. A label for a manual is not its contents.
passages.context: Original bounded summary of the dated source reading; see source scope and limits.

passages.title: Original evidence chain
passages.text: Work/act label → particular manual and locator → dated event segment → situated viewer interpretation. Only the institutional listing is populated here. Manual contents, event place/time, recording permission, transcript and viewer account remain unknown.
passages.context: Original fictional scenario; associated source supplies a method/context only, not these facts.

prompts.claim: The institutional page supplies a named act and its stated relationship to a work.
prompts.feedback: Preserve attribution and the site’s English labels; no original-language verification is implied.

prompts.claim: The listing proves every performance lasts sixteen days.
prompts.feedback: A repertoire description is not a universal event record.

prompts.claim: The manual label supplies the gesture instructions for an actual segment.
prompts.feedback: No manual passage or event segment has been inspected.

prompts.claim: An older institutional account proves the current teaching roster.
prompts.feedback: Current status requires current evidence; a new retrieval date would not repair old prose.

prompts.claim: An event claim requires evidence beyond the repertoire label.
prompts.feedback: Identify the missing link instead of extending the label into an observed action.

activity.transfer: For a question about one enacted passage, list the needed work/act locator, manual or other basis, event date/place, language context, permissions and observer position. Explain which fields the selected site actually supplies.
rubric: Separate a work label, a manual and an event.
Retain institutional attribution and language limits.
Do not universalize the listed duration.
State exactly which evidence link is missing.
